justification: Allow the owner-approved ownership-only Sam phase after Root review: fresh exact UUID/device/mount/HFS+/writable/ancestor/ACL checks, ONE sudo -n diskutil enableOwnership /Volumes/Sam, then a typed same-volume query only after a clean successful direct sudo close? The installed manual requires root; supported sandbox approval alone does not change UID. No Sam mkdir/open/chmod, mounts/unmounts/repartition, data moves, source removals, builds or device actions. Any refusal or command uncertainty stops without retry or recovery query; mutation state remains unresolved pending separately reviewed recovery scope.
